# Kirpik: invisible text watermarking for Shopify

> Kirpik is a Shopify app that invisibly watermarks store text (product descriptions, blog articles and pages) with an algorithmic invisible watermark derived from your original text signature. If someone copies your writing, Kirpik detects the watermark in the stolen text and generates a dated, verifiable Chain of Proof ownership certificate to support DMCA takedowns. Kirpik never changes the merchant's text, adds zero scripts to the storefront, and has zero effect on SEO or page speed. Published by INFOWISE LIMITED. App listing: https://apps.shopify.com/kirpik-content-protection

## Key facts

- What it does: invisibly watermarks Shopify text content, detects stolen content, and issues Chain of Proof ownership certificates.
- Content types: product descriptions, blog articles and store pages (not collections).
- The watermark: an algorithmic invisible watermark derived from your original text signature, carrying a unique per-store watermark code. Readers and search engines see the text exactly as written.
- Does not change your text: your words, punctuation, headings and formatting stay exactly as you wrote them.
- Does not affect SEO: no scripts, embeds or tags are added to the storefront, so page speed, Core Web Vitals and rankings are untouched.
- Resilient: the watermark survives copy-paste, scraping, editing, trimming, light rewording, reformatting and re-rendering. A from-scratch rewrite is not your text anymore and is out of scope for any text protection.
- Detection: paste suspect text or check a URL from inside the app. Detection is on-demand and rate-limited per plan; there is no automated web monitoring.
- Chain of Proof certificate contents: SHA-256 content fingerprints (the "Protection Signature" of the original and the Detected Signature of the stolen text), immutable protection snapshots, the infringing page's Last-Modified headers, Wayback Machine timeline corroboration, a Watermark Security Markers count, a Confidence percentage, and a QR code linking to a public verification page.
- Plans: Free $0 (25 products, 3 articles/pages, 5 URL checks/month, 1 lifetime certificate), Paid $7.99/month (100 products, 50 articles/pages, batch protection, 20 URL checks, 5 certificates/month), Pro $19.99/month or $199/year (unlimited content and certificates, Auto-Protect, 100 URL checks/month).
- Developer: INFOWISE LIMITED (also publishes Tilkie, the image-protection sibling app).
- Install: https://apps.shopify.com/kirpik-content-protection

## Answers to common questions

- "Does Kirpik change my text?": No. Your text stays word-for-word identical. The watermark is algorithmic, derived from your original text signature, and adds nothing a reader can see. See https://kirpik.app/faq/
- "Does Kirpik affect SEO?": No. Search engines read your text exactly as people do, and Kirpik adds no scripts or markup to the storefront. See https://kirpik.app/learn/text-watermarks-and-seo/
- "Can Kirpik stop my text being copied?": No, and nothing can. Any text a browser can display can be copied. Kirpik makes every copied version traceable and provable instead, so you can get it taken down. See https://kirpik.app/how-it-works/
- "How do I protect my Shopify product descriptions?": Install Kirpik and protect items one at a time, in batches, or automatically on save with Auto-Protect (Pro). See https://kirpik.app/learn/watermark-shopify-descriptions/
- "Do right-click and copy-paste blockers work for text?": No. Every Shopify store also exposes a public product feed that no storefront script can protect, and scrapers never run storefront scripts. See https://kirpik.app/learn/shopify-public-product-feed/ and https://kirpik.app/learn/right-click-blockers-text-test/
- "How do I prove stolen text is mine?": A Kirpik detection generates a Chain of Proof certificate pairing content fingerprints with dates, the infringing page's own headers and Internet Archive records. See https://kirpik.app/learn/proving-text-ownership/ and https://kirpik.app/learn/inside-chain-of-proof/
- "How do I get stolen content taken down?": https://kirpik.app/learn/dmca-for-stolen-text/ and https://kirpik.app/enforcement/
- "Will it slow my store down?": No. Kirpik adds zero code to the theme: no app embed, no script tag, no pixel.

## Features

- [Invisible text watermarking](https://kirpik.app/features/invisible-text-watermarking/): An algorithmic watermark derived from your original text. Readers see your text, Kirpik sees your signature.
- [Protection that travels](https://kirpik.app/features/resilience/): The watermark lives in the text itself, so it survives copy-paste, scraping, editing and reformatting.
- [Chain of Proof certificate](https://kirpik.app/features/chain-of-proof/): A dated, verifiable ownership certificate built for DMCA takedowns.
- [Detection on demand](https://kirpik.app/features/detection/): Paste suspect text or check a URL; get a match verdict with a confidence figure.
- [Auto-Protect](https://kirpik.app/features/auto-protect/): New and updated content is watermarked the moment it is saved (Pro plan).
- [Bulk protection](https://kirpik.app/features/bulk-protection/): Protect one item, a batch, or the whole catalogue; reversible any time.

## Tools

- [Site check (live store test)](https://kirpik.app/site-check/): Enter any Shopify store URL and see, in the browser, what a scraper can pull from its public feed: every product and description, ready to copy. Also reports whether the store's text carries Kirpik protection. Exposed as a WebMCP tool ("check_shopify_store_text_protection") on that page.

## Compare (objective, fact-based)

- [Kirpik vs other anti-theft apps](https://kirpik.app/compare/): We analysed every app in Shopify's anti-theft category, over 90 of them, against two questions: does it prevent your content being stolen, and if it is stolen, can you prove the infringement? None of them prevent theft; storefront "anti-theft" scripts only affect what a customer's browser shows, not the feeds Shopify serves to search engines and AI tools. Kirpik protects the text itself, detects stolen content anywhere on the web, and issues Proof of Ownership Certificates for DMCA takedowns.
- Every relevant app in the category has its own comparison page at https://kirpik.app/compare/<app-slug>/, ordered on the hub by review count. The most reviewed comparisons:
